description: This file defines the Month class which provides date calculation functions related to months, such as adjusting dates by a number of months and finding the last day of a month relative to a given date. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, specifically handling datetime computations within Excel-like date operations.

classes.name: Month
classes.description: Provides static methods for date calculations involving months, such as adjusting dates by months or finding the last day of the month, used within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: adjust
methods.description: Adjusts a given date by a specified number of months, returning the resulting date in various formats depending on context.

methods.name: lastDay
methods.description: Calculates the last day of the month relative to a given date, considering an adjustment in months.
